extracted.intended_audience: readers and contributors to Nature (scientists, authors, correspondents, and advertisers)
extracted.subtask_description: Page is an issue of the journal Nature (1907) containing book reviews, advertisement/specification notices, publication/purchase instructions, and an explicit editorial notice about letters and manuscripts; useful as guidance for contributors and advertisers to the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters to the Editor policy
rubrics_metrics.description: The Editor does not hold himself responsible for opinions expressed by correspondents; the Editor cannot undertake to return, or to correspond with, writers of rejected manuscripts intended for this or any other part of Nature; no notice is taken of anonymous communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and correspondents should supply their names (no anonymous communications will be considered); do not expect returned manuscripts or correspondence about rejected submissions; be aware the Editor disclaims responsibility for opinions published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announcements (Births, Marriages, Deaths) advertisement format and payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Announcements of Births, Marriages and Deaths are inserted in the advertisement pages of Nature at 3s. 0d. for two lines of eighteen words. Each additional line of nine words costs 1s. Each order should be accompanied by remittance to cover cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit announcements in the specified length (two lines of 18 words); each additional 9-word line incurs an extra charge; include payment with the order to ensure insertion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy/purchase pricing and distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Copies can be obtained through any bookseller, or post-free from the Publishers on receipt of 6d. from residents in the British Isles, or 9d. from residents abroad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Persons seeking individual copies should remit the stated postage amount to the publishers to receive post-free delivery; booksellers may also supply copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria for a practical manual (review: The Half-tone Process)
rubrics_metrics.description: A practical manual should treat the subject in a strictly practical way: omit obsolete methods and historical details; avoid excessive minuteness about apparatus that every worker must buy; give only necessary information for using apparatus to best advantage; restrict theoretical considerations to the simplest necessary points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include clear practical instructions and necessary formulae (e.g., for making negatives, printing, etching, finishing, mounting, proofing); assume general knowledge where appropriate (e.g., in advanced chapters) and focus on additional manipulations needed; supply numerous useful illustrations; ensure the manual aids intelligent use of apparatus rather than overloaded theoretical exposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure and content for an entomological pest catalogue (review: The More Important Insects Injurious to Indian Agriculture)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective pest lists give the technical name of each insect, one or two references of interest, a short concise description of the insect, short notes on distribution, biology and food plants, and finally the author's opinion as to the status of the insect as a pest. Figures of adults and, where relevant, larvae should be included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow a systematic order; keep descriptions concise but informative; include references and distribution/biological notes; state clearly the pest status; include illustrative figures to aid identification; such a method provides a solid foundation for economic entomology compilations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Components of an annual rainfall report (review: British Rainfall, 1906)
rubrics_metrics.description: The plan of the rainfall volume is divided into (i) original papers and organisation reports, and (ii) monthly and yearly rainfall tables, particulars of wet periods, and observers' notes on principal meteorological occurrences of the year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include detailed tabular data (monthly/yearly), narrative reports and organisational notes, maps (e.g., showing rates of movement of storms), particulars of notable periods (wet/dry), observers' annotations, and illustrative maps/figures (e.g., frontispiece colored map showing relation to averages) to render the volume useful and timely for public bodies and researchers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attributes valued in student-oriented scientific books (review: Modern Lithology and other textbooks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Books valuable to students should contain examined and accurately coloured plates or illustrations, clear explanatory letterpress explaining the figures, an index, and a concise useful glossary; practical usefulness and clarity of exposition are emphasized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design textbooks with accurate illustrations (coloured where helpful), explanatory text that directly references figures, an index for navigation, and a glossary that concisely defines terms; such features increase the book's utility for students and instruction.
